records.jp: 今だよヒナちゃん！　フラグメントを固定化して
records.en_original: Now, Hina! Stabilize the Fragment!
records.en_auxiliary: Now, Hina! Stabilize the Fragment!
records.en: Now, Hina-chan! Stabilize the Fragment!

records.jp: どうしたの、ヒナちゃん？<CR>今朝と同じようにすれば大丈夫だよ
records.en_original: What's wrong, Hina? Just do what you did this morning.
records.en_auxiliary: What's wrong, Hina? Just do what you did this morning.
records.en: What's wrong, Hina-chan? Just do what you did this morning.

records.jp: ひ、ヒナちゃん……？
records.en_original: H-Hina...?
records.en_auxiliary: H-Hina...?
records.en: H-Hina-chan...?

records.jp: ……もしかして、不安？<CR>今度は失敗するんじゃないかって
records.en_original: ...Could it be that you're scared? That you're worried you might mess up this time?
records.en_auxiliary: Could it be that you're worried you might mess up this time?
records.en: ...Could it be that you're scared? That you're worried you might mess up this time?

records.jp: 図星ね
records.en_original: Thought so.
records.en_auxiliary: Thought so.
records.en: Thought so.

records.jp: だって、さっき私のせいで凛は……。<CR>それなのに理解することなんて……
records.en_original: I'm the one who upset Rin earlier... I don't know if I'll be able to empathize with her.
records.en_auxiliary: I mean, I'm the one who upset Rin earlier... I don't know if I'll be able to empathize with her.
records.en: I'm the one who upset Rin earlier... I don't know if I'll be able to empathize with her.

records.jp: ……大丈夫だよ、ヒナちゃん
records.en_original: ...It's alright, Hina.
records.en_auxiliary: It's all right, Hina.
records.en: ...It's alright, Hina-chan.

records.jp: この付近の魔物は倒しちゃったから、<CR>もうリンリンの暴走は収まってきてるはず
records.en_original: We've already care of the demons around here, so Rin-Rin shouldn't be going rampant anymore.
records.en_auxiliary: We've already taken care of the monsters around here, so Rin-Rin shouldn't be going rampant anymore.
records.en: We've already care of the demons around here, so Rin-Rin shouldn't be going rampant anymore.

records.jp: ヒナちゃんが固定化に失敗したとしても、<CR>リンリンが傷つくことはないよ
records.en_original: Even if you mess up the stabilization, she's gonna be fine.
records.en_auxiliary: Even if you mess up the stabilization, she's gonna be fine.
records.en: Even if you fail to stabilize it, Rin-Rin won't be hurt, Hina-chan.

records.jp: でも……。それなら、無理に固定化しなくてもいいんじゃ……！
records.en_original: Then...why go through the trouble of stabilization?
records.en_auxiliary: Then why go through the trouble of stabilization?
records.en: Then...why go through the trouble of stabilization?

records.jp: けど、それだとリンリンと気まずいままで、<CR>ずっと避けていくことになるよ。それでもいいの？
records.en_original: If you don't, things'll stay awkward between you two and you'll avoid each other forever. Is that what you want?
records.en_auxiliary: If you don't, things'll stay awkward between you two and you'll avoid each other forever. Is that what you want?
records.en: If you don't, things'll stay awkward between you two and you'll avoid each other forever. Is that what you want?

records.jp: それは……
records.en_original: Not exactly...
records.en_auxiliary: Not exactly...
records.en: Not exactly...

records.jp: フラグメントの、リンリンの声をちゃんと聞いてみて
records.en_original: Listen carefully to what Rin-Rin's Fragment is trying to tell you.
records.en_auxiliary: Listen carefully to what Rin-Rin's Fragment is trying to tell you.
records.en: Listen carefully to what Rin-Rin's Fragment is trying to tell you.

records.jp: どんな思いで相談したのか。なんで暴走しちゃったのか。<CR>まずは聞かなきゃ何も始まらないよ
records.en_original: What made her want to ask for your advice? Why did she go rampant? You won't get anywhere unless you listen first.
records.en_auxiliary: What made her want to ask for your advice? Why did she go rampant? You won't get anywhere unless you listen first.
records.en: What made her want to ask for your advice? Why did she go rampant? You won't get anywhere unless you listen first.

records.jp: ……わかった。やってみる
records.en_original: ...Okay. I'll give it a try.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Okay. I'll give it a try.
records.en: ...Okay. I'll give it a try.

records.jp: （どうして自分で決められないんだろう……）
records.en_original: (Why can't I decide on my own...?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Why can't I decide on my own...?)
records.en: (Why can't I decide on my own...?)

records.jp: これは……。やっぱり、このフラグメントは凛のだったんだ
records.en_original: This is... They were right, this is Rin's Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: This is... They were right, this is Rin's Fragment.
records.en: This is... They were right, this is Rin's Fragment.

records.jp: （ホントはわかってる。自分で決めなきゃいけないって……）
records.en_original: (I know I have to make the decision myself. I know that, but...)
records.en_auxiliary: (I know I have to make the decision myself. I know that, but...)
records.en: (I know I have to make the decision myself. I know that, but...)

records.jp: （でも、私……。決めるのが怖い……。決めたらもう、戻れない）
records.en_original: (But I'm scared... I'm too scared to make a choice. Because once I do, there's no turning back.)
records.en_auxiliary: (But I'm scared... I'm too scared to make a choice. Because once I do, there's no turning back.)
records.en: (But I'm scared... I'm too scared to make a choice. Because once I do, there's no turning back.)

records.jp: （成功したい。けど、もし失敗したら……）
records.en_original: (I want things to work out. But if they don't...)
records.en_auxiliary: (I want things to work out. But if they don't...)
records.en: (I want things to work out. But if they don't...)

records.jp: 私も一緒なのかも……。<CR>ずっと決断できなかった……
records.en_original: It was the same for me, too... I had a decision that I just couldn't make for the longest time.
records.en_auxiliary: It was the same for me, too... I had a decision that I just couldn't make for the longest time.
records.en: It was the same for me, too... I had a decision that I just couldn't make for the longest time.

records.jp: 怪我して、バレエを失った時、<CR>バレエのない人生を生きるって決められなかった……
records.en_original: When my injury took ballet from me, I couldn't bring myself to make the choice to live a life without ballet.
records.en_auxiliary: When my injury took ballet from me, I couldn't bring myself to make the choice to live a life without ballet.
records.en: When my injury took ballet from me, I couldn't bring myself to make the choice to live a life without ballet.

records.jp: 決めて、前に進むのが、怖くて……
records.en_original: I was so scared of making the decision to move on...
records.en_auxiliary: I was so scared of making the decision to move on...
records.en: I was so scared of making the decision to move on...

records.jp: ……はぁ。……できた
records.en_original: ...Phew. ...I did it.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Phew. I did it.
records.en: ...Phew. ...I did it.

records.jp: お疲れさま、ヒナちゃん
records.en_original: Nice work, Hina!
records.en_auxiliary: Nice work, Hina!
records.en: Nice work, Hina-chan!

records.jp: ……はぁ。ありがとう
records.en_original: *huff* Thanks.
records.en_auxiliary: *Huff* Thanks.
records.en: *huff* Thanks.

records.jp: いきなり一日に二度もフラグメントの固定化をしたから<CR>疲れちゃったんだね……
records.en_original: Having to stabilize two Fragments in your first day as a Reflector must've really tuckered you out...
records.en_auxiliary: Having to stabilize two Fragments on your first day as a Reflector must've really tuckered you out...
records.en: Having to stabilize two Fragments in your first day as a Reflector must've really tuckered you out...

records.jp: さっきまで、あんなに動いても、疲れなかったのに……
records.en_original: I didn't feel tired at all back there, and I was moving all over the place...
records.en_auxiliary: I didn't feel tired at all until just now, and I was moving all over the place...
records.en: I didn't feel tired at all back there, and I was moving all over the place...

records.jp: ライムたちリフレクターは感情のエネルギー<CR>“エーテル”を使って戦ってる
records.en_original: We Reflectors fight using Ether, which is basically emotional energy.
records.en_auxiliary: We Reflectors fight using Ether, which is basically emotional energy.
records.en: We Reflectors fight using Ether, which is basically emotional energy.

records.jp: だから、感情に直結するフラグメントの固定化は<CR>一番エネルギーを消費するの
records.en_original: Because stabilizing a Fragment has you connecting directly with someone's emotions, it uses the most energy.
records.en_auxiliary: Because stabilizing a Fragment has you connecting directly with someone's emotions, it uses the most energy.
records.en: Because stabilizing a Fragment has you connecting directly with someone's emotions, it uses the most energy.

records.jp: エーテル？　フラグメントじゃなくて……？
records.en_original: So we need Ether, not Fragments to fight?
records.en_auxiliary: So we need Ether, not Fragments, to fight?
records.en: So we need Ether, not Fragments to fight?

records.jp: うん。エーテルは活動するのに絶対になきゃいけない、<CR>空気みたいなもの
records.en_original: Yeah. Think of Ether like air: you need it to do anything.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. Think of Ether like air—you need it to do anything.
records.en: Yeah. Think of Ether like air: you need it to do anything.

records.jp: ふうん……
records.en_original: Hmm...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm...
records.en: Hmm...

records.jp: じゃあ、そろそろ戻ろう！
records.en_original: Alrighty, let's head on back!
records.en_auxiliary: Alrighty, let's head on back!
records.en: Alrighty, let's head on back!
